id.description: The `columnId` of an existing column in the audience whose values should be included as context for the AI when generating values for the column, OR the `id` of a knowledge base attribute configured.

name.description: Display name of the column shown in the UI and returned in row responses.

dataType.description: Data type of the column. Optional for AI columns; required for static and ZoomInfo match columns.

isDeletable.description: Whether this column can be deleted via the Delete Column endpoint. Read-only; set by the system.

isEditable.description: Whether this column's value can be updated via the Update rows endpoint. Read-only; set by the system.

isExportable.description: Whether this column's values can be included in data exports. Read-only; set by the system.

isFilterable.description: Whether this column supports row filtering via the filterCriteria. Read-only; set by the system.

isFrozen.description: Whether this column is pinned (frozen) to the left in grid views. Optional; defaults to `false`.

isHidden.description: Whether this column is hidden from grid views. Optional; defaults to `false`.

isSortable.description: Whether this column supports row sorting via the List Rows endpoint. Read-only; set by the system.

columnType.description: Column type indicating the source and type of this column.

prompt.description: Formula or AI prompt used to generate values for this column. Returned for `FORMULA` and `AI` columns.

tool.description: Optional AI tool used to process this AI column. Returned for `AI` columns if a tool was selected.

dataDependencies.description: List of data dependencies that provide context to the AI model for this column. Returned for `AI` columns if data dependencies were specified.

scriptConfiguration.description: Optional script configuration for `FORMULA` columns. Includes generated formula language and expression.

matchCriteria.description: List of match criteria defining how rows are matched against ZoomInfo data. Returned for `ZOOMINFO_MATCH` columns.

ReadColumnAttributes.description: Base attributes shared by all column types in an audience.

language.description: Expression language used for formula evaluation.

expression.description: Generated formula expression evaluated for this column.

ScriptConfiguration.description: Optional script configuration returned for `FORMULA` columns. Contains the generated expression and its language.

SourceOrigin.description: Indicates how the audience was originally populated. Read-only; set by the system based on the creation method.
